name: sales-prospecting
description: Fixed five-read, read-only B2B prospecting bundle: bounded ICP company search, bounded professional search at one known company, privacy-limited enrichment of one known professional, independent verification of a supplied work email, and company enrichment. Requires nine coherent inputs, reveals no personal emails or phone numbers, and sends no outreach.

companyKeywords.description: Concise ICP keywords for company discovery, such as 'B2B SaaS'.

location.description: One target geography used by the company and professional searches.

employeeRange.description: One employee-count range in provider format 'lower,upper', such as '51,200'.

jobTitle.description: One professional title to search at the known target company.

seniority.description: One supported seniority: founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, or intern.

companyDomain.description: One bare company domain, without scheme or path, used for professional and company research.

firstName.description: First name of one known professional at the target company.

lastName.description: Last name of one known professional at the target company.

workEmail.description: One authorized work email to verify independently for deliverability.
